attBesluta.text: Complicado de armar pero vale la pena el resultado es hermoso, la suerte que no me tocó armarlo 🙈😂

This bar looks great in my poker room. Doesn’t take up a lot of room while providing great storage for bottles and glasses. My only complaint is alignment issues while assembling. My problem came right at the beginning with the assembly of the base. Other than that this is a nice bar.

great value for the money. lots of bottle storage on the 2 shelves underneath. looks awesome in the corner recess. my only complaint was with the assembly instructions. some parts were not numbered as they were labelled in the manual. took me about an hour and half to build, by myself. really sturdy once everything was tightened up.

I’m in love with this comfy beautiful couch! I’m very happy with this purchase and can’t wait for it to be completely inflated. Pictures are of when I just opened it. It inflated automatically. Firm high off the ground so easy to get up and out of sofa. Same size as my old second hand couch, true to size soft corduroy material. Arrived on time with no issues I added pillows for style. Very impressive. Thank you very much.
I cannot say enough about how great this is. Just know that it does need pillows purchased for back support because the back slopes. We love it! So cozy and easy to get.
I love in a very cold environment so it's taking longer to fully expand that it probably should. The back is shorter than I was expecting and it's stiffer than I thought but overall it's decent.
It doesn't easily show signs of wear in daily use, maintaining its beauty over time.
Great value, easy assembly, overall very happy with purchase, the measurements are incorrect on the listing. Overall width is 30.31" not 27.56" as listed in the description.
Built a new dog yard and this gate done the trick. was pleasantly surprised by the quality.
Ottima la possibilità di adattarli in base alle misure. Se ci fosse stato verde avrei preferito, l'ho pitturato.
Preis Leistung völlig in Ordnung. Lieferung ok und Kundenservice absolut empfehlenswert. Danke
